metadata.notes: USB ALSA scan of B0..BF with CC 0x57 value 0x03 mapped several commands. Confirmed by direct hardware observation: B0/B1/B2/B3 select scenes 6/7/8/9, B7 selects scene 1, B9 PLAY, BC REW, BD FF. B4 causes RESET. BE causes a transport mode the user described as OVERBURN; exact official label still needs verification. BA/BB/B5/B6/B8/BF not yet mapped by this scan.

commands.name: PLAY
commands.description: Playback command verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: PLAY
commands.description: Playback command. Verified on hardware over the USB ALSA Mixer Control Port with MIDI bytes BA 57 03.

commands.name: FF
commands.description: Fast-forward command verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: REW
commands.description: Rewind command verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_MODE
commands.description: Enters/activates scene operation mode: SAVE / RECALL / DELETE indicators blink. Verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_RECALL
commands.description: Triggers RECALL for the currently selected scene. Verified on hardware over USB ALSA.

commands.name: SCENE_SELECT_7
commands.description: Selects scene 7; leaves scene operation pending until RECALL.
